name: IHC - WITH REPORTING BONE MARROW COMPREHENSIVE DIAGNOSIS

data.value:
Custom IHC Panel

IHC No- 430/2024
Gross :-  Received one paraffin tissue block No. H-3471/24
Clinical Details : Known case of AML, marrow to assess disease status

Gross: Received 4 slides labelled 2217676 comprising of 2 stained BMA slides, 1 PS and 1 Retic count along with one paraffin block labelled H-3471/24.

BMA – 213/24

Peripheral Smear – Pancytopenic smear. RBCs are normocytic normochromic. Total leukocyte count is reduced. DLC done in 50 cells N; 02, L; 47, M; 01. Platelets are reduced. Reticulocyte count 0.1%.

BMA- 

Fragments: Seen

Smears: Paucicellular and hemodiluted.

Differential count: Plasma cell; 05, Erythroid precursors; 18, My; 01, MMy; 03, N; 01, L; 70, M; 02.

Few hematopoietic elements of all three lineages seen show essentially normal morphology.

Impression: Bone marrow aspirate smears are hemodiluted. Definite opinion is not possible.

 

Bone marrow biopsy – 1 H&E stained section and 1 paraffin block labelled as H-3471/24. 

Microscopic examination – 

Adequate bone marrow biopsy showing a normocellular marrow (~50% cellularity). The cellular elements comprise of hematopoietic elements of all 3 lineages. No definite clusters of immature cells noted. There is prominence of plasma cells lying singly scattered as well as in small clusters. These plasma cells show essentially normal morphology.

Interpretation: Normocellular marrow showing no definite increase in immature cells.


IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY RESULTS

IHC MARKER(S)                      RESULT
CD 34 No immature cell clusters noted. Overall <5%.
CD 117 No immature cell clusters noted. Overall <5%.
CD 138 Plasma cells are seen singly scattered as well as in small clusters. Overall percentage ~20-25%.
KAPPA and Lambda Scattered plasma cells show almost equal proportion of kappa and lambda positive cells.


IMPRESSION: The biopsy analysed doesn’t show any increase in immature cells.

Plasma cells are increased. There is no definite evidence of clonal restriction.

However, Serum protein electrophoresis and Free light chain assay are advised to look for any evidence of clonal gammopathy.


 Notes :
 1. This test was performed on paraffin embedded tissue section.
2. Detection system used – Biogenex  Real Envision Detection system, peroxidase/ DAB + Rabbit/mouse.
3. The impression is based on the material submitted and is not a complete surgical pathlogy report.
4. Improper Fixation may affect results. 
5. This assay has not been validated on decalified tissue. 
 Fixative requirement :
 1. The volume of formalin fixative should be atleast 10 times the volume of the specimen
2. Specimens should be immersed in 10% neutral buffered formalin within 1 hours of the biopsy/ resection procedure ( time of removal and time of immersion to be mentioned )
3. In all resection (large) specimens , the tumour must be bisected prior to immersion in fixative.
